scope: Current /conversion browser workflow, public session/conversion/file API, and API lifecycle behavior affecting conversion and retrieval. Includes browser, separately started API, and focused in-process environments.
excluded: Old synchronous upload flow as active behavior; only retired-route compatibility remains in scope.
Implementation plans, infrastructure setup, generic UI primitives, telemetry, and future distributed processing.
documentedLimitations: Reload or a new tab cannot resume a batch because browser credentials are not persisted.
Page-exit cancellation is best effort; conversion continues if it is lost.
Sharp/native and HEIC work lack hard wall-clock termination.
The current design runs one API process per storage root.

tests.asserts: Deadline sets the access message, stops uploads, and blocks subsequent cancel and download calls.

cases.given: A completed image is available and its download fails
cases.then: The completed result remains available and the browser retries the same download.

tests.name: retains a completed result and permits download retry after a transport failure
tests.environment: In-process deterministic mocked browser services
tests.asserts: Failure sets retry guidance without changing the completed file; retry invokes download again and clears the error.

tests.name: shows download failure and keeps the completed image available for retry
tests.environment: In-process jsdom with deterministic mocked HTTP responses
tests.asserts: The rendered error appears beside the enabled completed-image download; retry requests the file again and clears the alert.

cases.given: An operation snapshot is shown
cases.when: They view the active conversion screen
cases.then: The screen shows the server-provided session expiry in local time so completed images can be downloaded before the deadline.

tests.name: shows the server-provided session expiry in local time
tests.environment: In-process jsdom with deterministic operation snapshots
tests.asserts: The visible deadline and time element use the snapshot expiry and update when it changes.
